glosses: to condescend, to patronise, to treat as less than adult
jemanden oder etwas umsorgen, verwöhnen, sich hingebungsvoll um jemanden kümmern

examples.text: Meine Mutter hat mich mal wieder von vorn bis hinten betüdelt, als ich am Wochenende da war. Schön ist es ja, aber auch anstrengend.
Du sollst mich nicht immer so betüdeln, lass das, Finger weg von meinen Haaren und Finger weg von meinen Klamotten.

translations.source_sense_description: jemanden oder etwas umsorgen, verwöhnen, sich hingebungsvoll um jemanden kümmern

glosses: A person, especially a man or a boy, who is pampered and overprotected.

examples.text: You have been bred up as a molly-coddle, Pen, and spoilt by the women.
No matter what pacifist "flubdubs and flapdoodle mollycoddles" might say, the President [Teddy Roosevelt] knew that if there were a general war then America could well be drawn into it.

glosses: To be overprotective and indulgent toward; to pamper.

examples.text: Heerendorp by this means obtained an evil notoriety, and it was ordered to be burnt, and the women of Jacob's family to be transferred to a concentration camp where they would be mollycoddled at the expense of the English taxpayer.
Rich countries also need more competition in traditionally mollycoddled sectors such as education.
